claims.harm: makes implicit construction from byte spans to transaction_identifier possible again, bypassing type safety protections
claims.quote: This makes implicit construction from any byte span to `transaction_identifier` possible again.
claims.settled_by_quote: I've dropped this commit from this PR and moved it to #33034.

claims.harm: ReadPragmaInteger throwing would propagate and set database status to FAILED_LOAD instead of FAILED_VERIFY on verification failures
claims.quote: Before, on `Verify()` failure (return `false`) `MakeSQLiteDatabase()` would have set `status = DatabaseStatus::FAILED_VERIFY` and now (exception) it would set `status = DatabaseStatus::FAILED_LOAD`. Is this ok?
claims.settled_by_quote: I've changed this to catch the exception and return `std::nullopt`.

claims.harm: sqlite3_column_text can return nullptr, potentially causing undefined behavior when constructing a string without a null check
claims.quote: `sqlite3_column_text()` can return `nullptr`, better check that. The previous caller did check
claims.settled_by_quote: Done, returns an empty string now.

claims.harm: ignoring sqlite3_finalize return values in the destructor prevents signaling errors to callers
claims.quote: Some of the callers of `sqlite3_finalize()` used to check its return value. Here in the destructor it is too late to signal an error to the caller... Ignoring the return value does not look good.

claims.harm: unconditionally initializing all statement objects upfront in short-lived batches adds unnecessary overhead and complexity
claims.quote: I think it would be cheaper and less complicated to initialize statement objects just before they are used in the various `Read*()` `Erase*()` , and it takes better advantage of the fact that statements are RAII
claims.settled_by_quote: However, we can construct the `SQLiteStatement` on first use instead of always, so I've added a commit to do that.

claims.harm: uncompiled trailing SQL is silently ignored when multiple statements are passed to sqlite3_prepare_v2 without checking pzTail
claims.quote: provide the `pzTail` argument and throw an error if `pzTail` is not Null after `sqlite3_prepare_v2` (this indicates that there is uncompiled SQL code left)
